controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-zeek.ssh-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T00:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp <= "2026-07-13T23:59:59.000Z"
  AND (source.ip == "172.18.0.12" OR source.ip == "172.18.0.6")
| STATS count = COUNT(*) BY source.ip, destination.ip
| SORT count DESC
| LIMIT 20
